build_azure_ai_cohere_config: build an AzureAICohereConfig instance to transform OpenAI embedding requests for Azure AI Cohere endpoints
transform_request_embeddings: transform a mixed list of text and base64 image inputs into separate embedding requests with index tracking
transform_request_image_embeddings: transform a list of base64-encoded image strings into an ImageEmbeddingRequest for Azure AI
transform_response_usage: transform an EmbeddingResponse to extract token usage and map the Azure model group back to the original Cohere model
map_azure_model_group: map an Azure model group identifier back to the original Cohere embedding model name
